answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake plus a unique hardware attestation before it can transact. Reputation then accrues slowly, like quartz growing a new layer: a fresh identity in the tundra of zero history earns nothing until it completes verified work. A sybil attacker must fund a stake and wait out the accrual for each fake, while one misbehaving identity loses its stake — the pigment of its record stains every later identity tied to the same attestation. Ten thousand fakes cost ten thousand stakes and ten thousand waiting periods.
